changelog: **Settings checkboxes no longer stretch.** The check "X" was stretching into a long line across the panel because layout widened every control under 40px to 400px, and the template's checked texture uses SetAllPoints. **Works out of the box.** Available to group, questing buddies, and dungeon matching are on by default. **A streamlined Guild tab.** Your card still has a portrait, name, level, class, and a class-specific role picker. **The list only shows people who want the same thing.** Matches / All guild are gone. **Need help reaches higher-level helpers.** When you need help, the list is not limited to nearby levels. **Demo covers every status.** Turn on Demo (or `/codex demo on`) and switch pills to preview dungeon, questing, and Need help lists, including a level 60 helper.
